title: FNAF Foxy Running
blurb: Foxy does not creep. When Pirate Cove finally empties he sprints the length of the west hall, and this hammering run is the last thing you hear before the door either closes in time or does not. It is the one genuinely fair jumpscare in the original Five Nights at Freddy's: you get a warning, roughly a second of it, and the outcome depends entirely on whether your hand was already on the button. A decade on, the footsteps still make veterans flinch. Ideal for announcing an urgent and deeply unwelcome arrival.
origin: Foxy's hallway sprint from Five Nights at Freddy's (2014).
